caption:
Saturday, 10:42 AM. Your phone rings once and stops.

That caller doesn't leave a voicemail. They call the next shop on the list.

Most service businesses miss this window entirely. The first business to respond usually wins the job.

The Black Arrow platform catches it anyway. A missed call fires an automatic text in seconds, so the lead hears back before they finish dialing the next number.

Test it on your own business line for 14 days. Full access, no card, cancel anytime.
